INSERT INTO totp_recovery_codes (id, org_id, user_id, code_hash, created_at,
                                              updated_at)
             VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4,
                     timestamptz 'epoch' + $5::bigint * interval '1 microsecond',
                     timestamptz 'epoch' + $5::bigint * interval '1 microsecond')
